The '''Legacy arms''' were a type of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The weapons were appreciated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. One of these arms was the [[Model 38 sharpshooter's rifle/Legends|Model 38 sharpshooter's rifle]].<ref name="ETU" />
